observation: Run 39209401787 returned HTTP 420 after OIDC verification; code read only the first 100 connected accounts then mapped an empty match to not_public without distinguishing a truncated list from a truly absent project-authorized account.
root_cause: Project-scoped Composio Netlify discovery did not follow next_cursor; diagnostic did not log sanitized pagination counts. A mismatched Composio project is a separate unresolved possibility.
intervention: Read up to 20 cursor pages with a strict bounded timeout; reject malformed JSON, repeating cursors and incomplete scans; log only counts and a boolean; preserve OIDC, exact site ID, provider gate and fail-closed behavior. Added daily and workflow_dispatch OIDC-only backup health probe on the same protected workflow; probe does not build or publish.
expected: No silent false missing-connection classification caused by account pagination. If zero active Netlify accounts remain after a complete scan, retain a hard external authorization blocker and require a properly authorized service account. A nightly health probe fails loudly for missing bridge authority without triggering a production build.
